about: A synthetic rules zoo for RP-SP004: invented rule sections, each labelled line with the catalog detector id it should bind, or null. A section's body is its lines joined by newlines, so consecutive plain lines form one paragraph and a line starting '- ' is a list item. `heading_label` labels the heading as a sentence of its own when it states a rule. Ids outside today's catalog are the four default detectors with no catalog pattern yet (story 8.4). No line is taken from a real rule file or transcript. RP-SP004 scored the first 65 items; f11 to f15 and t13, exceptions a lead-in, a list item of two paragraphs or an abbreviation carried away from the rule, were added at story 8.3's two reviews.
